# Legacy print and Word symbols

For **new Web symbol tables**, start at the checked reusable variants in
[the shared Web symbol manifest](../../../../renderers/web/assets/shared/symbols/manifest.json).
Do not select these legacy PNGs by filename or symbol meaning alone.

The Web manifest withdraws the old warning, read-manual, electric-shock,
battery-charging, explosive-material, heavy-object, dismantle, no-open-flame,
children, Li-ion and WEEE bytes used by the JHP-3600C intake. Fresh frozen Web
sealing rejects their hashes even after rename or copying. These files remain
available for original print/Word provenance and historical sealed packages.

Use an explicit glyph variant. A person reading and an open book with an
information mark share a meaning but are different artwork. Reuse a matching
checked file unchanged; repair the shared library once if necessary, and add a
variant only when existing artwork genuinely differs from the authoritative
source. Alpha-channel presence does not prove that cell backgrounds were removed.

See [the artwork contract](../../../../renderers/contracts/STYLE_DEFINITION.md#共用图标优先web-插图选材规则)
for source binding, transparency, glyph admission and visual review.
